references.shows: The parts diagram shows the platter, spindle, S-shaped tonearm, recessed pitch slider and lower-left transport controls.
Manufacturer photos of the later professional deck show the exposed platter, thick plinth and S-shaped arm with rear counterweight.

silhouette: A single low rectangular professional turntable with a broad record platter, a curved tonearm and a separate vertical pitch slider.
features: One platter with a single record, spindle and dotted strobe rim.
An S-shaped tonearm, headshell and rear counterweight on the right.
Recessed pitch fader and scale next to the tonearm sweep.
Start/stop, power and speed controls at the lower left.
iconFeatures: One platter at the left of a rectangular deck and an arm at the right.
avoid: A second deck, a central mixer, or a gramophone horn.
notes: A professional direct-drive DJ deck based on the SL-1200MK2 parts diagram. The existing single-deck icon uses the same view at small size.

geometry.view: High three-quarter from the DJ side, dust cover off
geometry.proportions: A low plinth carries one dominant record platter. The shorter near edge shows the chassis depth.
geometry.partLayout: Offset the platter left of centre. Place the arm pivot at the back right, the pitch fader along the right edge, and the transport switches at the front left.
